meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Rainy Mood: hide the app promo video and badge; show, blur or hide the rain canvas; dim or hide mixes; trim streaming links.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) and an iPhone UA (390x844) on rainymood.com/. The /watch?v= pages (embedded video pairings) were not opened.

LIVE counts: app-promo-video both home 1; app-badge both home 1; canvas-blur both home 1; canvas-hide both home 1; mixes-dim both home 1; mixes-hide both home 1; streaming-links both home 2. The page is hand-written; selectors use ids, a poster path (`appad`) and hrefs. The mix list is the single paragraph whose links start with /watch?v=, found with `:has(> a[href^="/watch?v="])`; no class exists on it.

Choices: Rain animation Show/Blur/Hide (blur 6px), Mixes Show/Dim/Hide (opacity 0.35).

NOT verified: pairing pages, the mobile app banners (none seen), different regional versions, whether the canvas rain animation is the only effect.
